description: This file defines the PHP class 'ContactOpportunityRelationship', which models the relationship between contacts and opportunities in the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for related contact and opportunity IDs and names, database table configuration, and a method to populate additional details about related records.

classes.name: ContactOpportunityRelationship
classes.description: A model representing the relationship between a contact and an opportunity within SuiteCRM, handling database interactions and related data retrieval.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Loads additional details for the contact and opportunity associated with this relationship, populating contact_name and opportunity_name properties.
